sources.title: STEINS;GATE 比翼恋理のだーりん - PSP 攻略 組長式
sources.notes: PRIMARY, COMPLETE. Full page-by-page walkthrough: page 1 = common route (excl. Mayuri), page 2 = Moeka, page 3 = Faris, page 4 = Ruka, page 5 = Suzuha, page 6 = Kurisu, page 7 = Mayuri. Each page contains exact save points, verbatim dialogue/D-mail choices by date, mail-collection detours, and explicit 'next route' navigation links confirming the recommended play order (Moeka→Faris→Ruka→Suzuha→Kurisu→Mayuri). This is the primary source for save numbering and choice text.

sources.title: STEINS;GATE（シュタインズ・ゲート）比翼恋理のだーりん 攻略Wiki：ヘイグ
sources.notes: SECONDARY, COMPLETE. 58+ page community wiki with a dedicated page per route (プロローグ, 萌郁ルート, フェイリスルート, るかルート, 鈴羽ルート, まゆりルート, 紅莉栖ルート) plus 全メール回収, トロフィー, 実績, クリア特典. Site blocks direct fetch (HTTP 403) but is readable via a text-extraction proxy (r.jina.ai). Verified against dqff for the Moeka and Mayuri routes — chapter titles, save-point structure, and choice text are consistent between the two sources with no contradictions found. Used as the cross-validation source for every save/choice/bad-end before inclusion in the final guide.

sources.title: 【シュタインズゲート 比翼恋理のだーりん】攻略チャート - ゲームライン
sources.notes: Supplementary, largely complete. Has separate chart pages for 共通ルート(まゆり以外) (chart-1) and 共通ルート(まゆり用) (chart-2), giving the exact verbatim D-mail choice text for all five branch options at the common-route save point ('新ガジェットの開発は中止だ' / '12号機の開発は中止だ' / '12号機は危険だ絶対はめるな' / 'Dメール実験もっとよく考えろ' / no send). Used to cross-check the branch-trigger text against dqff and h1g.jp.

sources.title: 【比翼連理のダーリン 攻略】全ルート分岐・Dメール条件・ヒロイン別エンディング完全ガイド
sources.notes: Supplementary overview source. Confirms the D-mail branching mechanism, Mayuri prerequisite (avoid other heroines' flags), and the recommended order of saving Mayuri for last. Not used for verbatim choice text (summarized, not quoted).

sources.title: シュタゲだーりん攻略！各キャラエンディング一覧 | ゲイマー
sources.notes: Supplementary. Confirms the six route subtitle names (失楽のメランコリア / 猫耳乙女のドメイン / 倒錯のアニマ / 迷走螺旋のアルケー / 華氏93度のキアロスクーロ / 哀哭悲嘆のアポリア) and states no single true ending exists — consistent with the other sources.
